name: nunchi-codex
description: Nunchi V2 Codex room presence and authenticated-ingress guard.

interface.shortDescription: Host-owned Codex room presence with safe channel ingress.
interface.longDescription: Nunchi native adapters own authenticated observation, participant-shaped attention, Codex wake, and the single outbound commit point. The bundled prompt hook refuses unauthenticated raw channel markup and directs the operator to a native or HMAC-authenticated adapter; it does not derive platform facts from prompt text.
defaultPrompt: Explain how to run the host-owned Nunchi V2 Codex room presence.
